newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends down on central bank dlr buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends down on central bank dlr buying.

text.p: The won closed lower against the dollar on Wednesday after the central bank bought dollars in the afternoon to curb the won's rise, dealers said.
The central bank does not confirm its intervention.

The won finished at 888.00 against Tuesday's closing of 887.50. It opened at 887.50 and rose to the day's high of 887.20 during the morning session. But after the central bank purchased dollars at 887.30, the won fell to a low of 888.40.
Traders said banks, anticipating a central bank intervention, sold dollars cautiously ahead of expected month-end export negotiations.
But they were forced to buy dollars in the afternoon following the intervention, they said.
A dealer at Korea First Bank said the won would trade between 887.50 and 888.50 on Thursday.
He said $150 million of foreign funds for equity investment were expected for Friday and additional $160 million for early July which would strengthen the won.
